multiLabelPolicy: A run is accepted only when at least one specific detected category is explicitly allowed.
no_clear_deficit is mutually exclusive with every explicit deficit category.
Multiple deficit categories may coexist and remain visible; no category is silently discarded.
An allowed fully_meets result may accept no_clear_deficit even when an older annotation only listed a deficit path.
unknown and conflicting classifications always require review and never pass automatically.
